name: sst-ai-skills
description: Private SST AI Claude Code plugin marketplace: shared (common) and service-specific skills for SCM repositories.

plugins.name: sst-common
plugins.description: Shared by every SST repository, whatever its stack: the /review-code command, which runs the check-* skills (check-conventions, ...) of the other enabled plugins.

plugins.name: sst-be-common
plugins.description: Shared by every SST Java repository (cm-be-* and sst-fw-be-*): the backend development standards (バックエンド開発規約) and the catalog of the internal sst-fw-be-* framework.

plugins.name: cm-be-bff-common
plugins.description: Shared skills for the SCM BFF services (cm-be-bff-*): BFF feature scaffolding.

plugins.name: cm-be-ms-common
plugins.description: Shared skills for the SCM microservices (cm-be-ms-*): microservice feature scaffolding.

plugins.name: sst-fe-common
plugins.description: Shared by every SST Vue repository (cm-fe-* web and sst-fw-web): the frontend development standards (フロントエンド開発規約) and the Vue / API client conventions with the sst-fw-web catalog.

plugins.name: cm-fe-web-common
plugins.description: Shared skills for the SCM Vue web applications (cm-fe-web, manual-fe-web): screen scaffolding.

plugins.name: sst-mobile-common
plugins.description: Shared by every SST Flutter repository (cm-fe-mobile, sst-fw-mobile, sst-fw-widgetbook): the mobile development standards (モバイル開発規約) and the /create-comment command.

plugins.name: sst-fw-be-common
plugins.description: Shared skills for SST backend framework repositories (sst-fw-be-*).

plugins.name: cm-be-bff-web
plugins.description: Skills specific to cm-be-bff-web: JasperReports report and external integration scaffolding.

plugins.name: cm-be-spec
plugins.description: Skills specific to cm-be-spec: TypeSpec BFF and OpenAPI gRPC contract scaffolding.

plugins.name: cm-be-ms-log
plugins.description: Skills specific to cm-be-ms-log: log search/ingest feature scaffolding and AWS Athena client guidance.

plugins.name: cm-be-ms-dailyinv
plugins.description: Skills specific to cm-be-ms-dailyinv: dual-datasource (PostgreSQL + ClickHouse) feature scaffolding.

plugins.name: sst-fw-be-core
plugins.description: Skills specific to sst-fw-be-core: validation constraint scaffolding and extension utility guidance.
